Version 2.0.0 Summary:  
Major update with enhanced description generation and new customization features.

- Now supports advanced options like marketing trends integration and SEO optimization.
- Enables specification of product audience and export of generated descriptions.
- Expanded multi-platform and multi-style capabilities.
- Enhanced data-driven algorithms and conversion rate prediction.
- Improved usability with clear parameter explanations and usage examples.
